held_ms.description: Duration the user held control, in milliseconds.

note.description: Note from the return receipt. Only `released` delivers it, and only once — the receipt is consumed by that call.

SessionControl.description:
Who currently owns a session's page control.

`Agent` is the default: the daemon routes the agent's tool calls into the Agent Window. `User` (“held”) means the user pressed “Take over” in the Agent Window; interrupt-gated tool calls are rejected with `ErrorCode::UserAborted` until control is returned.

oneOf.description: The user returned control while we waited; `note` / `held_ms` carry the consumed return receipt.
Control was already `agent` when the call started (or a racing waiter consumed the receipt first).
The wait expired with control still held by the user.
